ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Terminal Profile Settings Modification By Uncommon Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation or modification of the Windows Terminal Profile settings file "settings.json" by an uncommon process.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND file_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Packages\\\\Microsoft\\\.WindowsTerminal\\_8wekyb3d8bbwe\\\\LocalState\\\\settings\\\.json$"))
